description.zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID。可调用[QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~)查询。
description.en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call [QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~) to query instance ID.

description.zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序。
description.en: The page number to start displaying from in the returned results. Pages start from 1.

description.zh:
任务状态：
- 0：初始化
- 1：无数据
- 2：运行中
- 3：运行成功
- 4：运行失败

若不设置此参数，表示选择所有状态。
description.en:
The task status. Valid values:
- 0: init
- 1: no data
- 2: running
- 3: succeeded
- 4: failed

If this parameter is not specified, all statuses are selected.

description.zh: 每页显示的条数。最小值为1，最大值为50，默认值为10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10.

descriptions.zh:
一体化以图搜图，表示搜图时，同时检索人脸和人体。
> 该功能需要在V系列边缘一体机上部署人脸和人体检测算法。
descriptions.en:
Integrated image search indicates that both face and body are retrieved simultaneously during image search.
> This feature requires the deployment of face and body detection algorithms on V-series edge devices.
